supersedes.reason: v1 incorrectly let firmware UART claim backend-only timing PASS; v2 separates firmware self-observation from the authoritative DMA-write sink verdict before any application implementation

application.name: PicoCalc Audio Conformance
application.kind: DMA-paced stereo PCM playback via public picocalc::audio API

pcm_packing.stream_source: successful 32-bit DMA bus writes to PWM5_CC; producer-side source hashing is not an acceptance oracle

source.origin: canonical BSP double buffer filled only through the public audio API
source.dma_retrigger_model: one 128-word half at a time until the finite stream drains

dma.timing_observation: hash and classify the DMA timer theoretical due cycle associated with each accepted transfer; separately report DMA service-cycle latency

firmware_self_observation: 49152 source frames were accepted without producer drop
underrun, drop and clip counters are zero
reported DMA fraction, PWM carrier and ring capacity match the BSP contract
backend_authoritative_observation: exactly 49152 successful DMA-origin 32-bit writes reached PWM5_CC
the little-endian write stream SHA-256 equals the independent oracle
each transfer was gated by DMA timer0 TREQ 59
theoretical DMA timer due-cycle gaps are only 5208 or 5209
the due-cycle stream is byte-identical across three runs
DMA service latency is reported separately
authority_split.overall_pass: requires both firmware_self_observation and backend_authoritative_observation; neither side may claim the other side's verdict

required_uart_markers: [NEXT2][AUDIO][DMA_CFG] status=pass treq=59 slice=5 dest=PWM5_CC width=32 fixed_dest=1 gpio=26/27
[NEXT2][AUDIO][STREAM] status=pass producer_vector=c66c76b2003a9e24fc16b3d9a6aa3bbc1cd0d6faf2d469244d9db3823d46367a accepted=49152 drain=complete underrun=0 drop=0 clip=0

required_evidence: complete periodically repeated UART marker block
acoustic capture containing the 1.024 second playback
hardware_correlation.emulator_oracle_note: The backend sink observed DMA write stream is the emulator oracle. R5 config/counters and hardware audio capture cannot substitute for it; hardware audio capture is secondary and non-byte-exact.
hardware_correlation.physical_audio_scope: Physical playback verifies the audible path only and never overrides a backend PCM hash mismatch
